Vercel then builds the preview the UX6 drive at 390 needs.

WHY YOU ARE ONLY HEARING NOW. Issue #149 was opened from the laptop by your own account, and GitHub sends "your own updates" by email only if you opt in, so it cannot be assumed to have reached you. This message comes from the Actions bot on the ops/session-log branch, the one branch the laptop can still push, on three channels: email, this issue, and the failed run you were emailed about.

This is band 7 of the stall (6 hours a band), so the next message cannot arrive for another 6 hours of silence. It stops by itself when a working branch is pushed.
